text:
hana: quick follow-up on the air-gapped upgrade RFC — proposing a "manifest-first, stream-lazy" quarantine flow to reduce disk pressure on constrained nodes. thoughts?

omar: curious how this differs from earlier quarantined proposals?

hana: main diff: we fetch only a tiny attachment manifest (checksums, component ids, compaction hints) into quarantine, run cheap crypto + schema checks, then stream blobs per-component only for VERIFIED items.

riley: that should help nodes with limited storage — avoid pulling full model shards up-front. rollout complexity?

hana: operator keeps an ActivationPlan with component-level markers. we allow partial activations; only components that reached ACTIVATING flip their local marker.

sam: sidecar vs builtin? my vote: sidecar for KMS/HSM isolation and easier RBAC.

hana: +1 sidecar. sidecar API small: VerifyAttachment(manifest_hash, component_id, activation_id) -> {VERIFIED|REJECT|RETRY, code}.

omar: GC policy? quarantined manifests are tiny but we still need eviction for stale plans.

hana: default TTL 48h and keep max 6 manifests or 1GB total for attachments, configurable. eviction prefers oldest non-activated plans. metrics: quarantine_manifest_count, quarantine_evictions_total.

riley: offline-escrow for air-gapped sites?

hana: yes — verifier supports escrow-mode: admin injects escrow keypair once (requires console ack). verifier does local signature checks against escrow keys. rotation via signed rotation manifest or manual maintenance approval.

sam: failure semantics? transient verifier failures -> retries; persistent -> QUARANTINED-REJECT and event. operator exposes remediation links in console.

omar: proto sketch? keep it tiny.

hana: posted a draft:
```
syntax = "proto3";
service Verifier {
  rpc VerifyAttachment(VerifyReq) returns (VerifyResp);
  rpc Health(Empty) returns (Health);
}
message VerifyReq { string manifest_hash = 1; string component_id = 2; string activation_id = 3; }
message VerifyResp { enum Status { UNKNOWN=0; VERIFIED=1; REJECTED=2; RETRY=3;} Status status = 1; string code = 2; string sig_hash = 3; }
```

riley: nice and compact. ensure code is machine parseable.

hana: will add numeric reason codes. also recommend activation_id = sha256(compact_manifest||cluster_id||ts) truncated to 12 chars for UX.

sam: rollout plan?

hana: phased: 1) sidecar + operator hooks in dry-run (verify-only) for 2 weeks on small canary; 2) enable streaming-attached activation for 10% clusters with 5m grace window; 3) expand slowly and monitor quarantine_evictions and activation_failures.

omar: include simulate_rejects flag for QA.

hana: good call. sidecar config sample: {simulate_rejects: bool, max_manifests: int, ttl_hours: int}.

ops-bot: <https://rwd.internal/rfcs/2026-11-manifest-first-attachment-quarantine|RFC-2026-11> posted to #architecture-rfcs, reviewers assigned: riley, omar, sam. :white_check_mark:

tess: i'll draft the console UX for escrow key injection and rotation flows.

hana: thanks — i'll update the RFC with the proto, GC defaults, and activation_id example. tagging reviewers @riley @omar @sam for final quick comments. :thumbsup:
